lxc_07f49244ae372743.text: Baseball is a top sport in Japan and several other countries.

lxc_b9d54d2dcf5134b8.text: Football is popular across the world.

lxc_931341da0dc75575.text: We can use three ideas: Do many people play it?

lxc_5526a5d7ca282a1c.text: Does it have a strong story or tradition?

lxc_555ac4ffa1f5bbb4.text: Football, also called soccer, is the world’s most popular sport.

lxc_2cc73feaafb12970.text: About 250 million people play it in more than 200 countries and territories.

lxc_266a64b913e95cee.text: Two teams of 11 players try to kick a ball into a goal.

lxc_c47a21a930b0a157.text: Football is easy to start: children often need only a ball and an open space.

lxc_dd5fdf597b73e17c.text: People can play at school, in a park, or in the street.

lxc_cd3144582eabc98f.text: This helps football become famous almost everywhere.

lxc_f831ac7fb2b79136.text: Big events help sports become more famous.

lxc_a55e69eb8e5cbb37.text: The FIFA World Cup happens every four years.

lxc_3b7495c57cc13f9f.text: About 1.5 billion people watched the 2022 final in Qatar.

lxc_6fa83030d423be73.text: Countries wait a long time for this special event, so it feels important.

lxc_da969c6cbf74071d.text: The Olympic Games are also famous.

lxc_04cd9f9d48dfff03.text: They bring many sports and countries together.

lxc_85fefc8a46691118.text: At Tokyo 2020, more than 11,300 athletes from 206 nations competed.

lxc_8d357948526153b1.text: Viewers can see running, swimming, football, and many other sports.

lxc_a5e40368697f9bc4.text: Basketball has two teams with five players on each side.

lxc_7f5882566c30c9e4.text: Players shoot a ball through a high hoop.

lxc_1ecb94b87b3a4534.text: The NBA is its most famous professional league, with 30 teams.

lxc_7c90a4f492ccc13b.text: School gyms and street courts also help people play the game.

lxc_9bddbb13a8ea498e.text: Tennis can be one player against one player, or two against two.

lxc_3090843868614649.text: Its four Grand Slam events are very famous.

lxc_35f299a26b084fb4.text: Wimbledon began in London in 1877 and is the oldest tennis tournament.

lxc_c4ba8ede85ee2367.text: Some sports are especially famous in certain parts of the world.

lxc_92a70a9939641ec1.text: Baseball is a top sport in Japan and the Americas.

lxc_b7123994f3eff73a.text: Two teams of nine players hit, throw, and run around four bases.

lxc_9d79e05c484033e1.text: The World Series is the championship of Major League Baseball.

lxc_fbf5984ff4ae6b02.text: Cricket is especially famous in South Asia, Australia, and England.

lxc_b4eef3fe97b0abd6.text: Two teams of 11 use a bat and ball.

lxc_c81ec64f5a5e9243.text: About 90 percent of cricket’s billion-plus fans are in South Asia.

lxc_6c35a4b49384ec0e.text: Place can make a big difference.

lxc_09a50a6cdd091adb.text: There is no single reason why a sport becomes famous.

lxc_e67853048ec4c303.text: Football is simple to start and has fans around the world.

lxc_37c71ac5b47f8bb8.text: The World Cup and Olympic Games bring many countries together.

lxc_1e438b6c17cf1480.text: Basketball has famous professional teams and local courts.

lxc_e0100faea94214cd.text: Tennis has old events such as Wimbledon.

lxc_ae330b34ce98fe5e.text: Baseball and cricket have strong local traditions.

lxc_de892ca9848c5714.text: A sport grows when children can play it, families watch it, and important games create exciting stories.

lxc_d40b5d80749d60c7.text: The most famous sport can also be different in each place.
